description: URL canonicalizer and lookalike-host check — Canonicalizes up to 50 absolute http(s) URLs for an agent about to fetch, dedupe or click them: WHATWG-parsed lowercase host, default port and fragment and userinfo removed, dot segments and unreserved percent-escapes normalized, tracking parameters (utm_*, gclid, fbclid and the Mozilla strip list plus yours) removed, and flags userinfo@host tricks, backslash and multiple-@ authorities, obfuscated

extraTrackingParams.description: Extra query parameter names to strip (case-insensitive).

publicSuffixes.description: Extra public suffixes (e.g. "co.xx") used for registrable-domain decisions.

sortQuery.description: Sort remaining query segments for a dedupe key. Off by default: order can matter to servers.

name: url-canonicalize
